summary: Frontend regression + bug-fix verification for chunk-loading fix (homepage='./' in package.json). All checks passed: splash/brand images render, About modal opens, ZIP archive successfully triggers dynamic import of libarchive.js chunk without any 'Loading chunk 506 failed' errors, viewer transitions from splash to mr-scroll with the extracted JPEG page rendered. Publicpath verified via curl.
seed_data_creation: Generated /tmp/test.zip containing a single JPEG (200x200 red) via Pillow for archive open flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Chunk loading bug is fully resolved. Web build serves chunks under ./static/js/*.chunk.js. Verified: HTTP 200 on /static/js/506.4acbbff0.chunk.js and /api/download/windows. In-browser ZIP upload via mr-file-input triggers libarchive.js dynamic import without errors and renders extracted image page. Splash naturalWidth=2000, Brand naturalWidth=2000. Zero console errors during full flow.
rca of the issue: Root cause was CRA/webpack defaulting publicPath='/'; in Electron file:// context this resolved to file:///C:/static/js/..., causing chunk 506 (libarchive.js dynamic import) to 404. Fix: added 'homepage': './' to /app/frontend/package.json so webpack.output.publicPath = './', producing relative chunk URLs that work in both http(s):// and file:// origins.
